messages:
maria: Heads-up — INF-CPU-High alerted for prod-east around 08:40 UTC. Seeing a bunch of noise (probably the autoscaler load test). Where does this currently route in PagerDuty?

dan: It goes to the `infra-prod` PD service, then into the eng-oncall rotation. Service: https://pagerduty.com/services/P12345 (config lives in infra/ops PD). If it's test noise we can either silence or tweak the Prom rule to include a `test_run` label.

lee: Dashboard + logs: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/cpu?var-cluster=prod-east and logs in Kibana — query `cluster:prod-east AND metric:cpu_high`. For quick context run:```kql
source:kubernetes AND cluster:prod-east AND message:/cpu/
```

sre-bot: Alert INF-CPU-High fired x3 in 5m for prod-east. Incident created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456 — auto-ack disabled.

maria: Thanks. Can we change routing so initial noisy alerts go to an alias (infra-alerts) instead of paging the person on call immediately? Would prefer alias -> team-silence -> escalate after 2m if still firing.

dan: I can update the PD escalation policy but need to coordinate maintenance windows. Two options: (1) add a suppression rule for alerts with label `test_run=true`, or (2) change the routing so first step is an alias that only notifies slack channel + email. Which do we prefer?

lee: For the load test tomorrow I'd prefer `test_run` label on the rule so we can silence programmatically. If we change routing globally we might hide real incidents. :thinking_face:

alex: We're running the load test tomorrow 09:00 UTC — planning to tag it. I'll add `test_run=true` to the job. I'll also open a maintenance window in PD before the test.

maria: Cool. I started a draft PR to add `test_run` to the Prom alert matcher and to update the rule comment with runbook link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/482 (WIP).

dan: SGTM. Once PR merges I'll create a PD silence and apply a short 30m maintenance window. I'll also prepare a small routing change script in case we need alias routing:```bash
# run as infra-admin
pd rota update --service P12345 --escalation "alias:infra-alerts->eng-oncall:2m"
```

maria: @lee can you approve the PR when it's ready? Also tagging @oncall to make sure people know about the maintenance window.

lee: Will review this afternoon, thanks. :thumbsup:

maria: One more Q — where do we change the escalation policy JSON? Is it in infra/ops/pd-config or in PD UI?

dan: The canonical config is in infra/ops/pd-config (repo). PD UI overrides are possible but we keep repo as source-of-truth. See README: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/tree/main/pd-config.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post an update in #eng-oncall when the maintenance window is set and PR merged.
